examples/advanced/06-share-your-setup/pl.description: Explains this repository's shared Claude Code setup to a new teammate, covering what is committed and shared, what stays personal, and what the team-kit plugin adds. Use when someone asks how the team's Claude Code setup works or what they get by cloning the repository.

examples/intermediate/01-first-skill/dot.description: Finds the root cause of a bug, failure or recurring problem by asking "why" until the answer is a cause you can fix. Use when the user asks why something keeps happening, or wants the root cause rather than a quick fix.

solutions/a-6/team-marketplace/plugins/t.description: The team's checklist for reviewing a change to linkcheck. Use before you commit or open a pull request.

solutions/a-capstone/dot-claude/skills/t.description: The team's review of a change to linkcheck, run the same way on a laptop and in CI. Use on a staged diff or a pull request.

solutions/i-1/dot-claude/skills/tdd.description: Builds a requested feature test-first, one behavior at a time, and stops at a diff for review. Use when the user asks for a new function or feature, or says test-first or TDD.

solutions/i-3/dot-claude/skills/changelo.description: Adds a one-line entry for the staged changes to CHANGELOG.md. Use when the user asks for a changelog entry.

solutions/i-capstone/dot-claude/skills/c.description: Runs the link checker on a folder and explains each broken link it finds, with the file, the line and a likely fix. Use when someone asks to check links or find broken links in the docs.
